name: cognia-agent-team-chibi
direction: One recognizable Cognia silver-haired companion expressed as sixteen professional Agent Team roles.

construction.grid: One shared 78% live-area keyline with generous optical padding
construction.identity: Reuse the same face, bangs, long silver-white hair masses, sapphire eyes, ear device, segmented halo, and cyan diamond core
construction.proportions: Cute 2.5-head chibi bust or half-body at one consistent eye level
construction.perspective: Front or gentle three-quarter view only
construction.stroke: Crisp slim deep-navy anime linework with rounded joins
construction.fillRule: Refined cel shading with one restrained cyan rim light
construction.detailBudget: One character, one role silhouette, and at most one compact prop or drone
construction.roleDifferentiation: Outerwear silhouette, expression, pose, and compact equipment
construction.weightHierarchy: Face and hair first, clothing second, role prop third
construction.shadow: No cast or contact shadow on the background
construction.motif: The segmented cyan halo, angular ear device, and cyan diamond core appear in every avatar
